html.title: B Level LV→EN: Match Rush + Prefix Forge

labels.legend:
Controls: Mouse clicks. — H help, R restart round, 1 Match, 2 Forge, D deck size.
📏 = Fit screen (no scroll), 📜 = Full deck (scroll if needed). LV→EN only.

help.title: Help
lines: ▶ MATCH RUSH — Click the pair: first LV word, then its EN meaning.
Mistakes in practice show a brief hint (e.g., -ties = reflexive).
Challenge mode has a timer and hearts.
📏 Deck Size — Toggle between 'fit screen' (no scrolling)
▶ PREFIX FORGE — Add the correct prefix to the verb root
(e.g., __mainīt → izmainīt) based on the given EN meaning.
Shortcuts: [1] Match, [2] Forge, [H] help, [R] restart, [D] deck size.

choices.instruction: Choose one replacement. You can try again after a wrong answer.

hints.title: Grammar hint
hints.generic: Check the passive pattern and the words around the repair slot.
hints.aux_tense: Use the time context to decide whether the action is happening now, happened before, or will happen later.
hints.negation: Decide whether the sentence says the action happens or does not happen, then keep the same tense.
hints.participle_agreement: Make the participle agree with the passive subject in gender and number.

feedback.ready: Choose a replacement to repair the sentence.
feedback.wrong: Not quite. That form does not make the target sentence.
feedback.wrongWithChoice: “{choice}” is not the form this sentence needs. Try another choice.
feedback.correctWithAnswer: Correct — “{answer}” is the exact form this sentence needs.

explanations.generic: The replacement restores the target passive sentence.
explanations.aux_tense: The auxiliary verb sets the tense of the passive sentence.
explanations.negation: The negative auxiliary shows that the action does not happen while preserving its tense.
explanations.participle_agreement: The passive participle must agree with the sentence subject in gender and number.
